concerns.location: plan.md:Phase Overview & FR/SC Mapping table (Phase 3 row)
concerns.text: FR‑007 requires graph construction to use a deterministic LLM prompt (fixed seed) for intent inference. The plan implements a rule‑based spaCy extractor instead (see Phase 3 description), which does not satisfy the FR‑007 specification. Consequently FR‑007 is not truly addressed.
